notes.notes: [p]Version 2.5.0:[/p][list][*][p]Improved accessibility in the interface and battles[/p][/*][*][p]Visual filters for colour/color blindness to improve readability[/p][/*][*][p]New sound effects for the interface, attacks, and spells[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous improvements and bug fixes, more stability and smoothness[/p][/*][/list]
[p]Update to improve accessibility experience for visually impaired players, especially in the goblin counting mini-game.[/p]

notes.title: Version 2.4.0
notes.notes:
Version 2.4.0
- Improved accessibility and added options for dyslexic and colorblind players.
- Ability to adjust music and sound effects volumes separately, with an option to mute them.
- Easy difficulty mode is now available in the free version of the game.
- Balanced the combat against Egelli.
- Added new sounds to enrich the gameplay experience.
- Completed quests are now visible in the quest board.

notes.title: Version 2.3.1
notes.notes:
Version 2.3.1:
- Improved accessibility.
- Added the player's nickname (if available) in mini-games.
- Enhanced views and fixed multiple bugs.

notes.title: Version 2.3.0
notes.notes:
Version 2.3.0

[list]
[*] New quest triggered when you win the card game at the tavern – this quest reveals the answer to the riddle at the first shop.
[*] Balancing of the spells "Stealth Attack" and "Flame Dance".
[*] Improved accessibility.
[*] All amulets are now available from level 6.
[*] Plus multiple minor fixes to enhance the gameplay experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 2.2.0
notes.notes:
Version 2.2.0:
- Makes the “Stronger Than Death” and “Lucky Day” achievements easier
- Increases the probability of triggering an effect for the player
- Fixes the player name display in the card mini-game
- Corrects the game’s intro screen

notes.title: Version 2.1.9
notes.notes:
Version 2.1.9:
- New system for filtering spell elements
- Rewrite of the first puzzle
- Instant creation of a new game for the Red Night Dungeon expansion
- Addition of the Czech language

Version 2.1.8:
 - Fixed translation issues
 - Updated the sound of rolling dice
 - Minor bug fixes
 - Added Hindi language
